name: Flat White
description: A double ristretto under a thin layer of silky microfoam. Smaller than a latte and stronger for it.

name: Oat Latte
tagline: Our house latte, oat by default
description: Espresso and steamed oat milk with a soft rosetta on top. Creamy, a little sweet, never heavy.

name: Cappuccino
description: Equal parts espresso, steamed milk and a deep crown of foam, poured into a tulip.

name: Iced Latte
description: A double shot poured over ice and cold milk, so it clouds as it settles. Stir it, or watch it.

name: Cold Brew
description: Coarse ground beans steeped cold overnight. Smooth, chocolatey and low in acidity. Black, or with a splash.

name: Matcha Latte
description: Uji matcha whisked smooth and topped with steamed oat milk. Grassy, gentle and bright.

name: Espresso
description: Our seasonal blend pulled short, with a thick hazel crema. Notes of cocoa, cherry and brown sugar.

name: Mocha
description: Single-origin dark chocolate melted into a double shot, then steamed milk and a heart.

name: Chai Latte
description: Black tea brewed with cardamom, ginger, cinnamon and clove, sweetened lightly and topped with foam.

name: Iced Matcha
tagline: Matcha poured over oat and ice
description: Bright matcha floated over cold oat milk and ice, so it sits in two colours until you stir.
